title: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose Mini-assessment
description: Check your understanding of 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: Does a visible label alone provide a standardized input-purpose token?
choices: No, the label and machine-readable purpose have different roles
Yes, all labels are autocomplete tokens
elements.correctAnswer: No, the label and machine-readable purpose have different roles
elements.feedback: Labels communicate with users; appropriate autocomplete tokens expose standardized purposes.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Which field is within the criterion’s scope when the technology supports it?
choices: A field collecting the user’s email address
elements.correctAnswer: A field collecting the user’s email address
elements.feedback: The user’s email is a listed input purpose; evaluate all applicability conditions.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Why should an order number not use autocomplete="email"?
choices: The token misrepresents the information requested
elements.correctAnswer: The token misrepresents the information requested
elements.feedback: A token should accurately represent the field’s purpose.
